test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: general
question: The sum of the curved surface area and total surface area of a solid cylinder is 2068 cm². If radius of its base is 7 cm, then what is the volume of this cylinder ? (use π = 22/7)
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Base Area = πr² = (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 154 cm².

CSA + TSA = 2 × CSA + 2 × Base Area = 2068.

2 × CSA + 2(154) = 2068 ⇒ 2 × CSA = 1760 ⇒ CSA = 880 cm².

CSA = 2πrh = 880 ⇒ 44 × h = 880 ⇒ h = 20 cm.

Volume = Base Area × height = 154 × 20 = 3080 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 3080 cm³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Radius (r) = 7 cm, CSA + TSA = 2068 cm².

**Formula Used:** CSA = 2πrh | TSA = 2πr(h + r) | Volume = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d04c3a21814b51605468c37f7d783ab516655cd877cd1de44d9beb7b0b2781fa.png] 

⇒ CSA + TSA = 2068

⇒ 2πrh + 2πr(h + r) = 2068

⇒ 2πrh + 2πrh + 2πr² = 2068

⇒ 4πrh + 2πr² = 2068

⇒ 4 × (22/7) × 7 × h + 2 × (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 2068

⇒ 88h + 308 = 2068

⇒ 88h = 2068 − 308 = 1760

⇒ h = 1760 ÷ 88 = 20 cm

⇒ Volume of Cylinder = πr²h

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 7 × 7 × 20

⇒ Volume = 22 × 7 × 20 = 154 × 20 = 3080 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 3080 cm³.**

**__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of Cylinder

The area of the curved part of the cylinder is CSA = 2πrh, where r is radius and h is height.

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

The sum of the area of the curved surface and the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of Cylinder

The capacity or space occupied by the cylinder: Volume = πr²h.

Hollow Cylinder Volume

The volume of material in a hollow cylinder is V = π(R² − r²)h, where R is outer and r is inner radius.</p
